description:
About our brand and products:
PONGBOT is a sports-tech brand dedicated to smart training robots for table tennis and tennis players of all levels. Our product range includes advanced table tennis robots and innovative tennis ball machines designed to make training more efficient, flexible, and enjoyable. We focus on combining intelligent technology, practical design, and reliable performance to help players practice anytime and improve faster.

What makes us different:
PONGBOT stands out through innovation, quality, and a strong focus on user experience. Our robots are designed with smart features, customizable training options, and easy operation to suit both beginners and advanced players. We aim to make professional-style training more accessible for clubs, coaches, families, and individual players.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates can earn a 10% commission on every successful order. We offer a 30-day cookie window, giving affiliates a solid opportunity to convert traffic into sales. Promotion options include affiliate links and coupon codes, making it easier to share offers and drive conversions.

Performance Bonus Program
In addition to the standard 10% commission, affiliates can unlock extra monthly rewards through our Performance Bonus Program. The more sales you generate, the higher bonus you can earn during each bonus period. This milestone-based system is designed to reward affiliates who consistently drive strong results and grow with us over time. Bonus rewards are based on the highest sales milestone achieved within the period.

Bonus Tiers:
Bronze Bonus — USD 20 for USD 3,000 in referral sales
Silver Bonus — USD 40 for USD 5,000 in referral sales
Gold Bonus — USD 100 for USD 10,000 in referral sales
Platinum Bonus — USD 180 for USD 15,000 in referral sales
Elite Bonus — USD 280 for USD 20,000 in referral sales
Champion Bonus — USD 400 for USD 25,000 in referral sales
Legend Bonus — USD 550 for USD 30,000 in referral sales

How to promote us:
Affiliates can promote PONGBOT through content creation, product reviews, blogs, YouTube videos, social media posts, community sharing, coaching recommendations, and direct referrals. Our products are especially suitable for creators and partners in sports, fitness, coaching, family activities, and tech-related niches.

We welcome affiliates who are passionate about sports, training, innovation, and active lifestyles. PONGBOT is looking to build long-term partnerships with creators, publishers, clubs, and communities who want to introduce high-quality training solutions to their audience. We value authentic promotion and mutually beneficial growth.
